text.title: North Star Metric Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable NSM signals (event data available, value-event candidate, cohort validation, input tree) to a rule from 01-core-rules.xml. Every leaf references a rule id.

decision-tree.root-question: Does the product have at least 8 weeks of per-account usage events and retention (or paid-conversion) data queryable in a warehouse or analytics tool?

conclusion.verdict: no data to validate a candidate against; instrument core events first and return with cohorts

branch.question: Is the leading candidate a count of a customer value event (usage or outcome), rather than revenue, signups, pageviews or undifferentiated MAU?

conclusion.verdict: reject the candidate; regenerate at least three value-event candidates and score them against the five criteria

branch.question: Has a cohort analysis on the product's own data shown that accounts above the candidate's threshold retain or convert materially better than those below, with cohort size and delta recorded?

conclusion.verdict: run the above-vs-below threshold cohort comparison and record it in the validation section before adoption

branch.question: Are three to five input metrics defined, each with an owning team, current value and target that the team can move within a quarter?

conclusion.verdict: decompose the NSM along breadth, depth, frequency and efficiency and assign owners before publishing the record
write the decision record with the computable definition, scored candidates, validation numbers, gaming guards and dashboard link

text.example: event_data_available=true -> value_event_candidate=true -> cohort_validated=true -> input_tree_defined=true -> conclusion ref=run-the-checklist
